🔥 From 1 October the energy price cap rises 4% — from £1,663 to £1,723 a year for a typical household. That's £60 more, with the gas element alone up 8%.

🌧️ It lands just as the heating goes on, and it hits gas-heated homes hardest — older housing, older residents, and a lot of the North.

⚡ Reform's answer: take the policy levies off household bills, get serious about our own domestic gas, and be honest about the trade-offs instead of burying them in a standing charge.
